scope: Re-audit OpenCADStudio as an optional ACIS application/kernel route; distinguish exact release identity, ACadRust-derived parser lineage, kernel lift/fallback, AcDs byte preservation, and native-consumer semantics.

method.kind: Public primary project release, source documentation, manifest, and issue review
method.evidenceRule: Treat project release notes, mutable documentation, issue comments, and self-round-trip reports as candidate or scoped implementation evidence only. Keep parser lineage, carrier/owner closure, kernel B-rep validity, app rendering, and operation-level consumer acceptance separate.

observed: The v2026.41 release resolves to short commit cff240e and contains a Cargo.lock.
The opencadcodec repository is identified as forked from hakanaktt/acadrust and advertises a native DWG/DXF codec.
OpenCADStudio is therefore one correlated parser lineage with ACadRust and consumers of that codec, not an independent DWG/DXF parser vote.
doesNotEstablish: the exact codec revision and feature closure at the selected release tag

findings.route: OpenCADStudio ACIS kernel lift and rendering
observed: The separate opencadkernel repository describes an acis feature that lifts codec SatDocument values to B-rep and calls the kernel early.
The current mutable tessellation guide documents kernel lift plus per-surface fallback for ACIS entities and an incomplete marker when faces do not all lift.
The exact v2026.41 kernel revision and equivalence of mutable docs to that release were not verified.
doesNotEstablish: complete B-rep lift of imported DXF/DWG ACIS entities
absence of fallback, incomplete faces, or repair
shape validity, closure, correct analytic metrics, or successful native operations

findings.route: OpenCADStudio issue #1078 same-version AcDs retention report
observed: A maintainer reports a same-version save preserving a 613-segment AcDs section byte-identically while correcting DWG Layout serialization on a supplied source pair.
doesNotEstablish: correct source entity-to-AcDs association for arbitrary documents
cross-version conversion or parsed ACIS semantics

nextActions: Continue local fast implementation without waiting for OpenCADStudio access or a peer run.

At the already-planned composed checkpoint, pin an exact app tag/artifact and hash; resolve the tag lockfile's codec/kernel commits, features, platform, and callable non-interactive route before opening any payload.
Use only a locally generated asymmetric ACIS control and independent expected geometry; keep it ephemeral and do not add external drawing fixtures.
Record source handle, owner/block path, inline or AcDs carrier association, bytes, and each output disposition before scoring the geometry route.

Require complete no-fallback B-rep lift, all-face/topology disposition, validity/closure and analytic metrics; if only rendering or MASSPROP is observable, report the narrower result without a semantic-solid pass.
Retain exact Linux/Windows native FreeCAD qualification as a separate gate; OpenCADStudio does not replace it or any J-specific external evidence.
